info.title: SHAPI advisory openai-legacy-gpt-o-series-shutdown-2026-10-23
info.summary: gpt-3.5-turbo, gpt-4, gpt-4-turbo, o1, o3-mini and o4-mini shut down on 2026-10-23

workflows.summary: Shows the change: On 2026-10-23 OpenAI shuts down gpt-3.5-turbo (0125), gpt-4 (0613), gpt-4-1106-preview, gpt-4-turbo, gpt-4.1-nano, gpt-4o-2024-05-13, o1, o1-pro, o3-mini and o4-mini, plus fine-tunes of gpt-3.5-turbo, gpt-4, gpt-4.1-nano and o4-mini. Only calls that send one of these model names (or their aliases) are hit; they fail from then on.

steps.description: POST /v1/chat/completions fails from 2026-10-23 when the body sends model = gpt-3.5-turbo
